display_long_description:
The station has been overrun. You have two pistols, a safe room, and one shift to get the numbers up.

HOW IT PLAYS
Choose a 5, 10 or 15 minute shift and step out of the safe room. Aliens hunt you room to room through the station's corridors, hangars, reactor and decks. They scream when they spot you and you can hear their footsteps coming from behind. Every kill counts. When the clock hits zero your shift is scored: aliens killed, your best for that level and shift length, accuracy and headshots.

DUAL-WIELD PISTOLS
A pistol in each hand, each on its own trigger, with real recoil, muzzle flash and ejecting brass.

SEVEN LEVELS
Station, Red Alert, Nebula Deck, Neon Nights, Deep Ocean, Toxic Lab and Candy Station. Each changes the whole station's look and the view out of the safe room's window, from a molten planet to a synthwave sunset.

THE SAFE ROOM
Aliens cannot get in. Catch your breath, take in the view, change level or music, and head back out.

MADE FOR COMFORT
Smooth locomotion with a fast-walk button, snap turning, and a pause that freezes the world. Time and kills stay off your screen until you want them.

FEATURES
- Single player, fully offline
- 5, 10 and 15 minute shifts with best scores for every level
- 7 levels and 9 original music tracks
- Dual-wield pistols
- Aliens that hunt, flank and chase you through a 19-room station
